card.text: M15 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 10,710 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 15 or M15 is a globular cluster in the constellation Pegasus.

introduction.text: M15 is drawn as 1,767 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
